ruling.recommended_action: Refund $9.79 (voucher) for the unexempted 6.94 km off-route segment F3; record the RD-1 violation on driver 1433 d account; no account flag (no upheld route dispute in 90 d).

segment_findings.reason: RD-4: the KPE accident (F13, reported 21:26, 0 m from the optimal route, lanes blocked) supports a reasonable-cause diversion in principle, but the segment swings up to 2240 m from the optimal route and its 6.94 km of extra mileage is far beyond what the corroborated incident can explain, so the excess is not exempt under RD-4; no rider agreement under RD-5 (chat F8/F9 predate the segment and mention no route change).
RD-4(c)/RD-5: no traffic incident (F11-F13) covers this later stretch and no chat agreement to the routing exists before the segment; unchallenged off-route segment under RD-1, refundable per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: The $16.41 billed excess is the raw difference between actual (27.5 km) and optimal (15.9 km) distance; RD-2 refunds only unexempted detour kilometres, i.e. $9.79, not the full billed excess.

Driver statement asserts unavoidable detour; it is only partially corroborated — F13/F12 support the fact of an incident on KPE but not the magnitude or the second swing, so it does not exempt the whole detour.
